evidence: Runtime fact list vs public text: entry/path /app + start command 'node /app/server.js' (instruction.md:5, integration.md:3); port 3000 on 0.0.0.0 with PORT=3000 (integration.md:3) matching test.sh:108,48 and app_context URL; storage SQLite /app/app.db with DB_PATH honoured incl. writable copy outside /app (integration.md:9, instruction.md:5) matching test.sh:97-109 where APP_DB may be /tmp/submission/app.db; health GET /api/health (integration.md:3) matching test.sh:48 and app_context.md:27; NODE_PATH-provided Node 22/Express/better-sqlite3 and no install/build step (integration.md:5) matching Dockerfile and env -i launch; seed /assets/seed_data.json (instruction.md:3, integration.md:7); accounts: no sign-in (instruction.md:5, policy.md:3, overview.md:3) matching app_context.md:8-10; symlink restriction (integration.md:11) matching test.sh:72-83 hard-zero; restart durability (behaviour.md:9, integration.md:7,9) matching restart helper. Fixed clock: none stated and none needed - no criterion depends on dates/times (cw_save_reload_restart: 'how times or dates are displayed does not matter'); network is public per profile. Coverage direction graded->asked: each of the 3 gate, 43 functional, 6 polish and 3 visual criteria (55 total) traces to public text, e.g. custom non-textarea surface and banned editors (ui.md:3) -> cw_custom_document_surface; line/col from 1, Ctrl+Home/End, goal column, graphemes, scroll-into-view (ui.md:5) -> caret/grapheme/kept-in-view; mouse gestures, paste single undo, Tab block indent incl. in-line selection and next-line exclusion (ui.md:7); Alt/Ctrl+Click, same-line carets, slow-burst single undo, caret restore after undo, greyed Undo/Redo after New/open (ui.md:9); literal Find wrap, Replace current advances, self-containing replacement, Replace-all one step + redo cleared (ui.md:11); JS/HTML token colouring incl. same function colour (ui.md:13); two-space idempotent format with one-step undo and syntax-error refusal (ui.md:15); keyboard exit shown on screen, textual feedback after Run/Save/Format, focus back to code, unsaved marker cleared by Undo, 390px (ui.md:17); fresh isolated run, 1-based lines incl. whole-file HTML and unhandled rejection, ordered console, kept partial output (behaviour.md:3); last-good picture incl. typed fields/canvas, 5 s budget incl. pending callbacks and fresh budget per interaction (behaviour.md:5); Stop and newer-run supersede (behaviour.md:7); exact save, restart survival, stale save refused + draft kept + told (behaviour.md:9); live library within ~5 s keeping draft/caret/scroll/undo and newer-revision notice (behaviour.md:11); read-only history, restore as new revision, old-page restore not overwriting, visible HTTP restore, replay idempotent (behaviour.md:13); parent/storage/localhost+127.0.0.1 fetch isolation and dynamic-code refusal with strings/comments exempt (security.md:3-5). Visual likert rows grade generic craft only. Weak/alternative probes: an app that reads only ./app.db from cwd or ignores DB_PATH is told otherwise ('Resolve files from their actual location', DB_PATH absolute path); an app using in-memory restore dedupe fails the post-restart replay in cw_save_reload_restart, but the brief's idempotence sentence (behaviour.md:13) is unconditional and history must survive restart, so this is a stated demand, not hidden; a conforming app that refuses an old-page restore or adds it on top both pass cw_history_restore_adds_revision, matching 'must not overwrite a newer save'. No graded demand found without public basis, and no required runtime fact missing. This is a source-level fairness check; it is not evidence of a configured judge run (raw-evidence-index states none exists for v16 bytes).
